rows.note: Use for a short, often unpleasant spell such as a bout of pain or coughing.

example.english: I had a bout of coughing last night, so I couldn't sleep.
example.traditional: 我琴晚有一陣咳，搞到成晚瞓唔着。
example.jyutping: ngo5 kam4 maan5 jau5 jat1 zan6 kat1 gaau2 dou3 sing4 maan5 fan3 m4 zoek6

rows.note: Use as the general choice for a longer period or spell, such as a period of drought.

example.english: There was a bout of drought in this area, and the crops nearly all died.
example.traditional: 呢區以前有一段時間冇乜雨，啲農作物差啲死晒。
example.jyutping: ne1 keoi1 ji5 cin4 jau5 jat1 dyun6 si4 gaan3 mou5 mat1 jyu5 di1 nung4 zok3 mat6 caa1 di1 sei2 saai3

rows.note: Use specifically for a boxing match rather than a general period or episode.

example.english: The boxing bout tonight was really exciting.
example.traditional: 今晚嗰場拳賽打得好精彩。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan1 go2 coeng4 kyun4 coi3 daa2 dak1 hou2 zing1 coi2
